period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported, Solo/Standalone -- 'BALANCE SHEET' heading without the 'CONSOLIDATED' prefix used elsewhere in the same filing, per project convention of preferring Solo over Consolidated). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2019 (as published in UCB's own standalone unaudited interim financial statements filed on ucb.com.bd's investor-relations Financial Statements archive -- a different, richer source than the FY2013-2016 annual-report-embedded audit-committee table used elsewhere in this dataset) -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix, same convention as FY2013-2016. Most of this era's UCB interim-statement PDFs (2017 through 2023, plus 2025 Q1/Q2) are pure image scans with no embedded text layer, requiring tesseract 5.5.3 OCR (150dpi full-document pass to locate the Solo Balance Sheet/P&L/Notes pages, keyed off page headings, since page layout/count varies by year); the 2024 and 2025 Q3 filings do have an embedded text layer but it uses a corrupted font character-to-glyph mapping that pdftotext cannot read for numeric cells, so those were instead re-rendered at 300dpi and OCR'd the same way. All PDFs were downloaded directly from ucb.com.bd and deleted immediately after extraction per project policy. paid_up_capital rose to 11,595,437,190 this quarter (from 10,541,306,540 in Q1/Q2 2019) following a bonus share issue; weighted-average shares for EPS purposes accordingly rose to 1,159,543,719. DISCREPANCY NOTE: net_profit_after_tax_cumulative is recorded here as 1,885,991,908 -- this quarter's own contemporaneously-reported figure (and its own EPS of 1.63 is consistent with it) -- but the FY2020 Q3 report's comparative ('Jan-Sept19') column later showed a different figure, 1,816,792,548, for the same period (a ~BDT 69.2m / 3.7% gap). Per project convention, the contemporaneous figure is kept; the later, unexplained restatement is recorded here for transparency rather than silently overwritten.
